'''Kurline''' was a type of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] that could be found in the deeper areas of the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]. The planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]] eventually adopted the name of the gemstone as a [[Gender/Legends|male]] Quarren name,<ref name="GCG" /> with Quarren shipping manager [[Kurline (Quarren)|Kurline]] being one such individual to share that name.<ref name="Gamer7">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kurline was mentioned in [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]]'s [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
